page.title: Bitcoin Price Outlook For November 2026: One Price Level Remains Critical
page.excerpt: Bitcoin price enters November defending $76,000, the average cost basis of short-term holders. The level was held after the Binance hack pushed BTC to a six-week low of $76,275. The shock from Binance triggered $1.58 billion in liquidations, and BTC closed October with a 7% loss.
